note: The British Indian Ocean Territory: no one has a right of abode; a permit from the BIOT Administration is needed in advance, issued only to yachts for safe passage and, on Diego Garcia, to those on pre-authorised official duty, so a performer's engagement there is official only. British citizens and the other territories' passports, though of the same nationality, need it too and are named; the territory's own are home.

sources.title: British Indian Ocean Territory Administration, Current travel advice
sources.said: The British Indian Ocean Territory is not a tourist destination. Access is restricted and a permit is required in advance of travel. There are no commercial flights and permits are only issued to yachts for safe passage. Access to Diego Garcia is only for those on pre-authorised official duty.
